item.title: Immigrant labor shortages impacting Louisiana crawfish industry
item.description: Louisiana Agriculture Commissioner Mike Strain says that due to immigration caps only a quarter of crawfish processors have been able to bring in the guest workers that they rely on.

item.title: Monroe PD searching for wanted 17-year-old suspect
item.description: MONROE, La. (KTVE/KARD) -- The Monroe Police Department is searching for 17-year-old Dekerryous Jones. According to authorities, Jones is wanted for Simple Escape. If you know his whereabouts, contact officers at (318) 329-2600.

item.title: Wossman dynasty claw back to championship mountaintop
item.description: Hammond, La. (KTVE/KARD)-- The Wossman High School girls basketball teams secures their fifth consecutive state championship with a squeaking win past Lagrange. The Lady Cats were led by Heaven Weeks who finished with 26 points.
